x: In the High Jump we had to rely on Juniors almost exclusively, with the exception of Bob Wise, who is torn between this event and quarter-miling, thereby, perhaps, not showing his best in either.
Bob Wise ran well in the Senior 440 Yards, and Len Bishop took third place in the 1 Mile with Micky Walker, having a change from marathon running, close behind him.

Jack Frost ran second in the 100 Yards, and also finished third in the 220, which was won by Teddy Read. Syd Jarlett and Bob Wise finished second and third in the 440, and Len Marchant won the 880 Yards, with Alf Orton fourth.
Bob Wise won the 440 for the South, and Blowfield beat Ken Stimpson in the 1 Mile. The 2 Miles Walk was won by Harry Churcher with Jack Rutland second and Len Fletcher third.
